findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, get_product, get_2fa, check_order_status, get_mail_code, wallet_history · Private data: get_2fa, check_order_status, submit_complaint, get_mail_code, create_usdt_deposit, wallet_history · Public sink: get_2fa, check_order_status, submit_complaint, get_mail_code, create_usdt_deposit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, get_product, get_2fa, check_order_status, get_mail_code, wallet_history · Private data: get_2fa, check_order_status, submit_complaint, get_mail_code, create_usdt_deposit, wallet_history · Public sink: get_2fa, check_order_status, submit_complaint, get_mail_code, create_usdt_deposit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
